admission_rule: Only family x trait systems with joint temporal-S3, temporal-prune-only and spatial informativeness PASS enter. If the final informativeness gate has fewer than 12 independent families, this design is not executed.

spatial: georef_protocol IS NULL OR georef_protocol <> 'county centroid'

continuous_scalar.temporal_species_state: median of all finite numeric eligible measurements in the unique frozen BIEN unit for that family x trait system
continuous_scalar.temporal_dissimilarity: absolute difference. Any positive affine standardization produces the same Spearman ranks, so the canonical-unit raw difference is used directly.
continuous_scalar.spatial_state: every eligible finite numeric measurement row
continuous_scalar.unit_rule: the exact single nonempty unit already validated by v0.3.3; no conversion or unit switching after outcomes

nominal_categorical.temporal_species_state: unique modal category; tied-mode species remain excluded exactly as in v0.3.3

temporal_effect.primary_tree: S3 tree containing prune + bind species
temporal_effect.primary_species_rule: same temporally resolvable species used in the frozen crosswalk, excluding fail-to-bind
temporal_effect.delta_rho_identity: exact permutation-null mean = 0, therefore delta_rho equals observed Spearman rho

prune_only_sensitivity.role: mandatory reported sensitivity, not a post-outcome exclusion rule because prune-only geometry already passed informativeness

spatial_effect.species_eligibility: same semantic-valid spatial species: >=20 records, >=5 frozen 25-km cells, >=2 observed states, all spatial validity filters
spatial_effect.separation: all unordered great-circle distances among eligible measurement rows within species
spatial_effect.duplicate_coordinates: retain all original measurement rows; zero-distance pairs remain in the full pair set
spatial_effect.system_aggregation: equal-species median of finite species-level rho values
spatial_effect.delta_rho_identity: exact within-species permutation-null mean = 0, so species rho and the equal-species median are the primary spatial effect

null_diagnostics.point_estimate_null_mean: analytic exact zero; never Monte Carlo estimated
null_diagnostics.seed: FNV-1a deterministic keys under master seed 20260930
null_diagnostics.temporal: whole species states permuted among eligible labels; report null SD only
null_diagnostics.spatial: whole measurement states permuted among observed coordinates within species; report species-level null SD and equal-species median diagnostic summary

outputs_forbidden: individual spatial species rho values in the committed primary result

h1_primary_coupling.unit: family x trait systems passing all gates
h1_primary_coupling.model: unweighted OLS spatial_rho ~ temporal_S3_rho with intercept and family-clustered CR2 standard errors
h1_primary_coupling.direction: positive slope supports common time-space coupling
h1_primary_coupling.secondary_descriptive: Spearman correlation between temporal_S3_rho and spatial_rho across systems, with family-cluster bootstrap CI
h1_primary_coupling.prune_only_sensitivity: replace temporal_S3_rho with temporal_prune_only_rho without changing the admitted system set
